# Evening summary template (utility category)

## Template name
`evening_summary_v1`

## Category
Utility (Meta approval required)

## Parameters carrying personal data
- `{{1}}` seller name (PII)
- `{{2}}` shop name
- `{{3}}` total amount (financial, not PII but sensitive)
- `{{4}}` entry count
- `{{5}}` date

No customer names or phone numbers are included (privacy).

## English text
"Hi {{1}}, your evening summary for {{2}} on {{5}}: {{4}} entries totaling {{3}}. Reply to review."

## Hindi text
"नमस्ते {{1}}, {{5}} को {{2}} का सांध्य सारांश: {{4}} एंट्री, कुल {{3}}. समीक्षा के लिए जवाब दें."
